data.title: The *reviewer*
data.subtitle: Long documents, answered with the exact wording and the page.

blocks.text: Checks long policies, contracts or tenders.
Answer a list of questions from one long document.

items: PDFs up to **1,000 pages**, **20 files** per chat

blocks.text: Answer my questions in a table: question, answer, exact quote, page. If it isn't covered, write Not covered. No outside knowledge.

items: A table you can check line by line
"Not covered" where the document is silent
Quotes reduce made-up answers but don't remove them
